title: The $13K Loan Secret Hiding in Plain Sight
actionable_recommendations: Form a corporate entity with an EIN before applying for the loan.
Open a business checking account once you have your corporate documents and EIN.
Create a basic business plan—10 to 15 pages—before applying for loans.
Double-check your personal credit score and improve it if necessary.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Loan approval for SBA microloans can be achieved with a minimum of 620 mid-FICO score.
Average loan amount approved for brand new businesses through SBA microloans is around $13,000.
QuickBooks can offer up to $60,000 in a line of credit, but higher amounts may require two years of tax returns.
major_ideas: Government-backed funding programs exist for small businesses.
SBA microloans are more accessible than traditional loans, especially for new businesses.
A mini business plan may be required for loan applications.
Use AI tools to quickly generate a basic business plan.
prerequisites: Corporate entity must be established with an EIN.
Business checking account must be opened.
A professional email and business phone number are recommended.
proposed_workflow: Set up a corporate entity with an EIN.
Create a basic business plan using AI tools.
Apply for an SBA microloan through approved partners.
tools_templates_resources: AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude for business plan generation.
Credit repair videos for improving personal credit.
SBA website for microloan lender lists.
CreditBoosterPlus.com and other credit repair services.
